files.content:
# Vendor sync - Northwind Systems - 2026-06-18

Attending: Dana Whitfield, Marcus Lee (Northwind); Priya Raman, me.

## What happened
- Walked the integration scope; Northwind demoed the sandbox tenant.
- Pricing came up again - they hinted the per-seat tier could move if we commit by Q3.

## Commitments
- We send the revised pricing tiers by July 1. (sent June 30 - done)
- Dana sends the data-migration timeline by June 25. (never arrived - still open)
- Both sides name a launch owner. (ours is Priya, theirs is Marcus - done)

## Parking lot
- Sandbox rate limits looked tight for our nightly sync - nobody owned this.
